payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information on how text is segmented into chunks for improved processing and understanding in machine learning models.

claims.text: Text is segmented into smaller chunks to encapsulate context and improve processing results, similar to audio segmentation.
The segmentation process involves dividing lengthy documents into distinct chunks that serve as inputs for neural networks, enhancing model performance.
Models trained on segmented text chunks show higher accuracy compared to those using the whole document as input.
Different models are created based on the number of chunks, optimizing each for better performance in document classification tasks.
